bullets.heading: Custom YOLO Fine-Tuning & False-Positive Suppression
bullets.text: Built and fine-tuned custom YOLO object detection models for an AI-powered CCTV surveillance platform across office and sports facilities — detecting persons, employee/visitor status, PPE, carried objects, and facility state. Improved mAP@0.5 from ~82% to ~91% by fine-tuning on 10,000+ annotated images (CVAT, Label Studio) with targeted augmentation under variable illumination.

bullets.heading: Edge & GPU Acceleration
bullets.text: Achieved real-time inference at 35–45 FPS on NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano Super edge appliances and 100+ FPS on RTX 5090 GPUs, developing GStreamer hardware decode/encode pipelines (nvv4l2decoder / nvv4l2h264enc) and CUDA video processing for 24/7 continuous multi-camera feeds.

bullets.heading: Face Recognition with Vector Search
bullets.text: Designed a high-speed identity-search engine using InsightFace / ArcFace facial embeddings stored in PostgreSQL with pgvector (HNSW indexing), enabling sub-millisecond nearest-neighbor similarity search for employee verification.

bullets.heading: Production SageMaker MLOps
bullets.text: Deployed production computer vision models as containerized real-time inference endpoints on Amazon SageMaker (ml.g5.xlarge / ml.g5.2xlarge), building custom Docker inference images and integrating automated CI/CD deployments with health monitoring.

bullets.heading: Hybrid Training Infrastructure
bullets.text: Orchestrated model training and experimentation across hybrid environments — SageMaker Training Jobs for cloud scalability, and a local dual-GPU server (2× NVIDIA RTX 5090, 64GB RAM) for YOLO training, LoRA fine-tuning of vision-language models, and rapid benchmarking before cloud promotion.

bullets.heading: GenAI Summarization & Cloud Security
bullets.text: Extended surveillance with LLM-based event summarization and RAG search; architected hardened AWS infrastructure (VPC, WAF, GuardDuty, Inspector, Config) that raised the cloud security benchmark to 80% while achieving HIPAA & SOC 2 compliance.

bullets.heading: Cost & Performance Optimization
bullets.text: Reduced operational cloud costs by 40% and enhanced system performance by 20% through infrastructure auto-scaling and automated CI/CD pipelines (AWS CodePipeline, ECR) for model artifact management.

bullets.heading: Exploratory Data Analysis
bullets.text: Conducted in-depth statistical modeling and exploratory data analysis (EDA) using R on real-world healthcare datasets to support clinical ML development.

bullets.heading: Statistical & ML Modeling
bullets.text: Applied linear regression, logistic regression, k-means, and hierarchical clustering to analyze clinical attributes and evaluate model baselines.

bullets.heading: Interactive Dashboards
bullets.text: Built interactive visualizations and dashboards using ggplot2, Plotly, and R Shiny to present data quality findings and model insights to stakeholders.
